subject.title: Skill setup detection false positive when credentials use config files instead of env vars

question: What credential-readiness contract should OpenClaw support for skills whose real credentials live outside declared environment variables?
rationale: The current behavior is source-reproducible, but any fix changes how OpenClaw trusts credential availability and may add a new skill metadata/API surface or host execution boundary.

options.title: Add declarative readiness sources
options.body: Define a manifest/SDK contract for env-or-file credential readiness with path/source limits, redacted diagnostics, and shared status/runtime/doctor behavior.

options.title: Allow skill-owned status/setup hooks
options.body: Let skills report or prepare setup with a reviewed consent, timeout, logging, sanitizer, and execution model, accepting the larger host-code execution surface.

options.title: Keep env-only readiness
options.body: Document that `requires.env` means env/config-apiKey only and ask skills with file fallbacks to model that differently or move to an external plugin flow.

recommendation.title: Add declarative readiness sources
recommendation.body: Define a manifest/SDK contract for env-or-file credential readiness with path/source limits, redacted diagnostics, and shared status/runtime/doctor behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans the original skills status/settings surface and shared requirements contract where steipete has the strongest history signal.
